scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix extensions/backend install
scripts.predev:pc: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='http://localhost:5173'; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && concurrently "npm run watch:frontend" "npm run start:neu"
scripts.prebuild:pc: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='/'; c.modes.window.openInspectorOnStartup=false; c.modes.window.enableInspector=false; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
